cond_0001.intro: The position will drive strategic sourcing related projects mostly focusing on, but not limited to, packaging for [Company name masked]. In this role, you will be responsible for flawless execution of sourcing strategies, cost savings initiatives, new vendor/product qualification and development, and vendor management. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing, this is a great opportunity for a proactive, detail-oriented professional who is looking for high visibility and the chance to be a key member of dynamic department with impact all the supply chain processes.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop, grow and maintain network of qualified suppliers of all primary and secondary packaging materials (i.e. PET, HDPE, Corrugated, Flexible packaging, Labels, etc.)
Develop and issue RFPs for all packaging sourcing related projects including but not limited to supply chain/logistics, professional services, capital projects
Act as the project manager and lead functional Marketing, Operations and Sourcing teams to drive new product and packaging update projects from concept to implementation
Responsible for meeting annual COGS targets by managing supplier contracts, spend and performance
Negotiate contracts and conduct financial analyses to achieve the optimum cost/value relationship
Understand and monitor key spending trends, cost drivers, market factors, geographic considerations, and strategic importance of critical commodities in order to implement appropriate sourcing strategies
Develop metrics, including external benchmarks, to monitor performance and allow for data-driven decision making
Stay up to date with new packaging innovations/technology and recommend cost saving opportunities
Work with operations, marketing and NPD team to develop and maintain detailed specification documents for all packaging materials which include technical drawings, testing procedures, AQLs, shipping formats, current artwork
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of sourcing experience, preferably in packaging
BS/BA in business, packaging engineering or related field
Strong leadership, relationship building and communication skills
Strong analytical thinking
Ability to present information in a clear and concise format to all levels of the organization
Excellent project management skills, especially in cross functional team settings
High attention to detail
High level of proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge in flexible and secondary packaging
Knowledge of printing technology

cond_0249.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Sourcing Analyst to join our team.
This role drives strategic sourcing projects with a focus on packaging. You will be responsible for executing sourcing strategies, cost savings initiatives, new vendor and product qualification, and vendor management. You will work closely with teams across Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing on a regular basis, and report directly to the Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing.
cond_0249.responsibilities:
Develop, grow, and actively maintain a network of qualified suppliers of primary and secondary packaging materials (e.g. PET, HDPE, Corrugated, Flexible packaging, Labels, etc.)
Develop and issue RFPs for packaging sourcing projects including supply chain/logistics, professional services, and capital projects
Act as project manager and lead functional Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing teams through regular collaboration to drive new product and packaging update projects from concept to implementation
Meet annual COGS targets by managing supplier contracts, spend, and performance
Negotiate contracts and conduct financial analyses to achieve the optimum cost/value relationship
Stay in close contact with key spending trends, cost drivers, market factors, geographic considerations, and strategic importance of critical commodities to implement appropriate sourcing strategies
Develop metrics, including external benchmarks, to monitor performance and support data-driven decision making
Stay current with new packaging innovations and technology and proactively raise cost-saving opportunities with the team
Work regularly with Operations, Marketing, and NPD teams to develop and maintain detailed specification documents for all packaging materials, including technical drawings, testing procedures, AQLs, shipping formats, and current artwork
cond_0249.requirements:
+3 Years of sourcing experience required, preferably in packaging
BS/BA in business, packaging engineering, or related field
Knowledge in flexible and secondary packaging a plus
Knowledge of printing technology a plus
Strong leadership, relationship building, and communication skills
Strong analytical thinking is required
Ability to clearly explain and present information to all levels of the organization
Excellent project management skills, especially in cross-functional team settings
High attention to detail is a must
High level of proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint

cond_0261.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Sourcing Analyst to join our team.
This role supports strategic sourcing projects with a focus on packaging. Working closely with the Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing, you will help coordinate sourcing strategies, cost savings initiatives, new vendor and product qualification, and vendor management across supply chain processes.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Help build and maintain a network of qualified suppliers for primary and secondary packaging materials (e.g. PET, HDPE, Corrugated, Flexible packaging, Labels, etc.)
Coordinate and issue RFPs for packaging sourcing projects including supply chain/logistics, professional services, and capital projects
Work alongside Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing teams to support new product and packaging update projects from concept to implementation
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to help meet annual COGS targets by managing supplier contracts, spend, and performance
Negotiate contracts and conduct financial analyses together with relevant teams to achieve the best cost/value outcome
Share insights on key spending trends, cost drivers, market factors, geographic considerations, and strategic importance of critical commodities to support appropriate sourcing strategies
Help develop metrics, including external benchmarks, to monitor performance and enable data-driven decision making
Stay current with new packaging innovations and technology and share cost-saving recommendations with the team
Work with Operations, Marketing, and NPD teams to develop and maintain detailed specification documents for all packaging materials, including technical drawings, testing procedures, AQLs, shipping formats, and current artwork
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of sourcing experience, preferably in packaging
BS/BA in business, packaging engineering, or a related field
Strong analytical thinking
Strong leadership, relationship building, and communication skills
Ability to present information clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization
Excellent project management skills, especially in cross-functional team settings
High attention to detail
High level of proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of flexible and secondary packaging
Knowledge of printing technology

cond_0339.intro:
We are looking for a Senior Sourcing Analyst to join our team.
This role drives strategic sourcing projects with a focus on packaging. You will be responsible for executing sourcing strategies, cost savings initiatives, new vendor and product qualification, and vendor management. You will work closely with teams across Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing on a regular basis, and report directly to the Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing.
cond_0339.responsibilities:
Develop, grow, and actively maintain a network of qualified suppliers of primary and secondary packaging materials (e.g. PET, HDPE, Corrugated, Flexible packaging, Labels, etc.)
Develop and issue RFPs for packaging sourcing projects including supply chain/logistics, professional services, and capital projects
Act as project manager and lead functional Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing teams through regular collaboration to drive new product and packaging update projects from concept to implementation
Meet annual COGS targets by managing supplier contracts, spend, and performance
Negotiate contracts and conduct financial analyses to achieve the optimum cost/value relationship
Stay in close contact with key spending trends, cost drivers, market factors, geographic considerations, and strategic importance of critical commodities to implement appropriate sourcing strategies
Develop metrics, including external benchmarks, to monitor performance and support data-driven decision making
Stay current with new packaging innovations and technology and proactively raise cost-saving opportunities with the team
Work regularly with Operations, Marketing, and NPD teams to develop and maintain detailed specification documents for all packaging materials, including technical drawings, testing procedures, AQLs, shipping formats, and current artwork
cond_0339.requirements:
+3 Years of sourcing experience required, preferably in packaging
BS/BA in business, packaging engineering, or related field
Knowledge in flexible and secondary packaging a plus
Knowledge of printing technology a plus
Strong leadership, relationship building, and communication skills
Strong analytical thinking is required
Ability to clearly explain and present information to all levels of the organization
Excellent project management skills, especially in cross-functional team settings
High attention to detail is a must

This role supports strategic sourcing projects with a focus on packaging. Working closely with the Senior Manager of Strategic Sourcing, you will help coordinate sourcing strategies, cost savings initiatives, new vendor and product qualification, and vendor management across supply chain processes.
cond_0405.responsibilities:
Help build and maintain a network of qualified suppliers for primary and secondary packaging materials (e.g. PET, HDPE, Corrugated, Flexible packaging, Labels, etc.)
Coordinate and issue RFPs for packaging sourcing projects including supply chain/logistics, professional services, and capital projects
Work alongside Marketing, Operations, and Sourcing teams to support new product and packaging update projects from concept to implementation
Collaborate with internal stakeholders to help meet annual COGS targets by managing supplier contracts, spend, and performance
Negotiate contracts and conduct financial analyses together with relevant teams to achieve the best cost/value outcome
Share insights on key spending trends, cost drivers, market factors, geographic considerations, and strategic importance of critical commodities to support appropriate sourcing strategies
Help develop metrics, including external benchmarks, to monitor performance and enable data-driven decision making
Stay current with new packaging innovations and technology and share cost-saving recommendations with the team
Work with Operations, Marketing, and NPD teams to develop and maintain detailed specification documents for all packaging materials, including technical drawings, testing procedures, AQLs, shipping formats, and current artwork
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
3+ Years of sourcing experience, preferably in packaging
BS/BA in business, packaging engineering, or a related field
Strong analytical thinking
Strong leadership, relationship building, and communication skills
Ability to present information clearly and concisely to all levels of the organization
Excellent project management skills, especially in cross-functional team settings
High attention to detail
High level of proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of flexible and secondary packaging
Knowledge of printing technology
cond_0405.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0405.values: We value excellence, focus, and the ability to produce strong outcomes. We believe organizations succeed when they hold themselves to a high bar.
